title: From AI Consumer to Governed Operator.
subtitle: Stop asking what the model can generate. Start defining what the business needs, who is authorized, and what counts as verified delivery.
source: Day Zero reference — candidate fixture, source authentication pending

layers.text: The request, its source, intended recipient, and handling destination.
What is known, where it came from, and what remains uncertain.
Compare delivered work with the declared standard and ground truth.
Human authorization—not model confidence—controls final release.
